bank.name: Prophets & Beliefs
bank.subject: Islamic Studies
bank.description: Articles of faith, angels, revealed books, and the stories of the prophets mentioned in the Quran.

questions.prompt: Who was the first prophet of Allah?
questions.explanation: Adam (AS) was the first prophet and the first human being.

questions.prompt: How many prophets are mentioned by name in the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Twenty-five prophets are mentioned by name in the Quran.

questions.prompt: According to a famous hadith, how many prophets were sent to mankind in total?
questions.explanation: A hadith mentions 124,000 prophets, of whom 315 are messengers.

questions.prompt: Which book was revealed to Prophet Musa (AS)?
questions.explanation: The Tawrat was revealed to Musa (AS).

questions.prompt: Which book was revealed to Prophet Dawud (AS)?
questions.explanation: The Zabur was revealed to Dawud (AS).

questions.prompt: Which book was revealed to Prophet Isa (AS)?
questions.explanation: The Injil was revealed to Isa (AS).

questions.prompt: Which prophet received the Suhuf (Scrolls)?
questions.explanation: The Suhuf (scrolls) were revealed to Ibrahim (AS).

questions.prompt: Which angel brought divine revelation to the prophets?
questions.explanation: Jibril (AS) is the angel of revelation.

questions.prompt: Which angel is responsible for taking the soul at death?
questions.explanation: Azrael (AS), the Angel of Death, takes the souls.

questions.prompt: Which angel will blow the Trumpet (Sur) on the Day of Judgment?
questions.explanation: Israfil (AS) will blow the Trumpet.

questions.prompt: Which angel is responsible for providing sustenance and rain?
questions.explanation: Mikail (AS) is entrusted with provisions and rain.

questions.prompt: According to Islamic belief, angels were created from?
questions.explanation: Angels are created from light, while jinn were created from fire.

questions.prompt: How many articles of faith (Arkan-e-Iman) are there?
questions.explanation: The six articles: belief in Allah, angels, books, prophets, the Last Day and divine decree.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is titled 'Kalimullah' (one who spoke to Allah)?
questions.explanation: Musa (AS) spoke directly to Allah, earning the title Kalimullah.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is titled 'Khalilullah' (friend of Allah)?
questions.explanation: Ibrahim (AS) is the Khalilullah, the friend of Allah.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was born without a father?
questions.explanation: Isa (AS), son of Maryam (AS), was born miraculously without a father.

questions.prompt: Which prophet rebuilt the Kaaba with his son Ismail (AS)?
questions.explanation: Ibrahim (AS) and Ismail (AS) raised the foundations of the Kaaba.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was thrown into a fire that, by Allah's command, became cool?
questions.explanation: Ibrahim (AS) was cast into the fire by Nimrod, and Allah made the fire cool and safe.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was swallowed by a great fish (whale)?
questions.explanation: Yunus (AS) was swallowed by the whale and prayed from its darkness.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is renowned for his extraordinary patience through severe illness?
questions.explanation: Ayyub (AS) is the example of patience in affliction.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was thrown into a well by his brothers and later became a ruler of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Yusuf (AS) was thrown into a well by his brothers and later rose to power in Egypt.

questions.prompt: Prophet Nuh (AS) is famous for building?
questions.explanation: Nuh (AS) built the Ark by Allah's command to save the believers from the flood.

questions.prompt: Prophet Salih (AS) was sent to which people?
questions.explanation: Salih (AS) was sent to Thamud, whose miracle was the she-camel.

questions.prompt: Prophet Hud (AS) was sent to which people?
questions.explanation: Hud (AS) was sent to the people of 'Ad, destroyed by a violent wind.

questions.prompt: Prophet Shu'ayb (AS) was sent to the people of?
questions.explanation: Shu'ayb (AS) was sent to Madyan, who were corrupt in trade.

questions.prompt: The story of Dhul-Qarnayn, the man of two horns, is mentioned in which Surah?
questions.explanation: The story of Dhul-Qarnayn is in Surah Al-Kahf (18).

questions.prompt: The People of the Cave (Ashab-e-Kahf) are mentioned in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Kahf tells the story of the sleepers of the cave.

questions.prompt: Who was the brother and helper of Prophet Musa (AS)?
questions.explanation: Harun (AS) was Musa's brother, sent as a helper.

questions.prompt: By which miracle did Musa (AS) cross the sea with Bani Israel?
options: The sea split into dry paths
questions.explanation: Allah split the sea for Musa (AS) and Bani Israel, drowning Pharaoh's army.

questions.prompt: Belief in Qadr means belief in?
options: Divine decree, both good and evil
questions.explanation: Qadr is the belief that everything is by Allah's decree, whether good or bad.

questions.prompt: Which prophet's name appears most frequently in the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Musa (AS) is mentioned more than any other prophet in the Quran.

questions.prompt: Prophet Zakariyya (AS) was the guardian of which blessed woman?
questions.explanation: Zakariyya (AS) was entrusted with the care of Maryam (AS).

questions.prompt: Prophet Yahya (AS) was the son of which prophet?
questions.explanation: Yahya (AS) was the son of Zakariyya (AS).

questions.prompt: According to Islamic belief, Prophet Isa (AS) will return before?
options: The end of the world after 100 years
questions.explanation: Muslims believe Isa (AS) will descend near the end of time before the Day of Judgment.

questions.prompt: The Day of Judgment is called?
questions.explanation: Yaum-ul-Qiyamah is the Day of Resurrection and Judgment.

questions.prompt: Belief in the angels is which of the articles of faith?
questions.explanation: The six articles: Allah, angels, books, prophets, Last Day, and divine decree.

questions.prompt: What is the fourth article of faith?
questions.explanation: The fourth article is belief in all the prophets of Allah.

questions.prompt: What is the sixth article of faith?
options: Belief in divine decree (Qadar), good and bad
questions.explanation: The sixth article is belief in Qadar — that all good and evil is by Allah's decree.

questions.prompt: Who was the first prophet sent to the people after Adam (AS)?
questions.explanation: Idris (AS), known as Enoch, is regarded as among the earliest prophets after Adam (AS).

questions.prompt: Prophet Nuh (AS) preached for how many years according to the Quran?
questions.explanation: The Quran says Nuh (AS) stayed among his people 950 years (29:14).

questions.prompt: Which prophet is called 'Abul-Anbiya' (Father of the Prophets)?
questions.explanation: Ibrahim (AS) is called Abul-Anbiya because many prophets descend from him.

questions.prompt: Which prophet had the miracle of the staff turning into a serpent?
questions.explanation: Musa's (AS) staff turned into a serpent before Pharaoh as a sign (20:20).

questions.prompt: Which prophet was given the miracle of healing the blind and the leper, by Allah's permission?
questions.explanation: Isa (AS) healed the blind and leper and raised the dead by Allah's permission.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is mentioned as speaking in the cradle as an infant?
questions.explanation: Isa (AS) spoke from the cradle to defend his mother Maryam (19:29-33).

questions.prompt: Which prophet was sent to the people of Israel and is known for his wisdom and iron-working?
questions.explanation: Daud (AS) was given the Psalms and the miracle of iron being softened (34:10).

questions.prompt: Which prophet ruled with the ability to judge between people and understood the speech of birds?
questions.explanation: Sulaiman (AS) was given dominion over wind, jinn and the speech of birds (27:16).

questions.prompt: Who is 'Zulqarnain' mentioned in the Quran?
options: A righteous king given great power who built a barrier against Gog and Magog
questions.explanation: Zulqarnain is a righteous ruler mentioned in Surah Al-Kahf who built a wall against Yajuj and Majuj.

questions.prompt: Prophet Khidr (AS) is mentioned in the Quran as a servant of Allah with which prophet?
questions.explanation: Khidr (AS) appears in Surah Al-Kahf as the teacher of Musa (AS) in three mysterious events.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was sent to the people of Yasin?
questions.explanation: Ilyas (AS), named in Surah As-Saffat, was sent to the people of Yasin (Baalbek).

questions.prompt: Which prophet is called 'Isra'il' and had 12 sons whose descendants became the tribes of Israel?
questions.explanation: Yaqoob (AS) is also known as Isra'il, and his 12 sons founded the tribes of Israel.

questions.prompt: Who was the brother of Musa (AS) who assisted him before Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Harun (AS) was Musa's (AS) brother, sent as a helper with eloquent speech.

questions.prompt: Which prophet led the Israelites into the Holy Land after Musa's (AS) passing?
questions.explanation: Yusha bin Nun (AS), Musa's disciple, led the conquest of the Holy Land.

questions.prompt: Which prophet rebuilt the city of Jerusalem after the captivity?
questions.explanation: Uzair (AS) is associated with the restoration of the Torah and Jerusalem after exile.

questions.prompt: Who was the mother of Isa (AS)?
questions.explanation: Maryam bint Imran (AS), the purest of women, was the mother of Isa (AS).

questions.prompt: Prophet Isa (AS) was born without a father. Who was his father according to the Quran?
options: He had no human father; created by Allah's word
questions.explanation: Isa (AS) was created miraculously by Allah's command 'Be' — with no human father.

questions.prompt: According to the Quran, Isa (AS) was not crucified but was?
questions.explanation: The Quran states Isa (AS) was neither killed nor crucified but raised up by Allah (4:157-158).

questions.prompt: Which prophet is expected to return before the Day of Judgment to fight the Dajjal?
questions.explanation: Muslims believe Isa (AS) will descend near the end of time to defeat the Dajjal.

questions.prompt: Who was the last prophet of the Bani Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahya (AS), born to Zakariyya (AS), is regarded as the last prophet before Isa (AS).

questions.prompt: Who was the wife of Pharaoh who believed in Musa (AS) and is praised in the Quran?
questions.explanation: Asiya, Pharaoh's wife, embraced faith in Musa's (AS) Lord and is cited as an example for believers (66:11).

questions.prompt: Who was the wife of Ibrahim (AS), the mother of Ishaq (AS)?
questions.explanation: Sara was the wife of Ibrahim (AS) and mother of Ishaq (AS); Hajar was the mother of Isma'il (AS).

questions.prompt: Who was the mother of Isma'il (AS)?
questions.explanation: Hajar, the Egyptian wife of Ibrahim (AS), was the mother of Isma'il (AS).

questions.prompt: Prophet Shu'ayb (AS) was the father-in-law of which prophet?
questions.explanation: Musa (AS) married one of Shu'ayb's daughters and worked for him (28:22-28).

questions.prompt: Which prophet was sold into slavery in Egypt and later interpreted the king's dream?
questions.explanation: Yusuf (AS) interpreted the king of Egypt's dream of seven fat and seven lean cows.

questions.prompt: The Quran mentions 'Ulul Azm' (the five great prophets). Who are they?
options: Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa and Muhammad (PBUH)
questions.explanation: Ulul Azm are Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa, Isa and Muhammad (peace be upon them all).

questions.prompt: Who is the last and final prophet of Islam?
questions.explanation: Muhammad (PBUH) is the Seal of the Prophets (Khatam-un-Nabiyyin) — the final prophet.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is known as 'Ruhullah' (Spirit of Allah)?
questions.explanation: Isa (Jesus) is called Ruhullah.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is called 'Safiyullah' (Chosen of Allah)?
questions.explanation: Adam is known as Safiyullah.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is known as 'Najiullah' (the one saved by Allah)?
questions.explanation: Nuh was saved from the flood.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was given the Zabur (Psalms)?
questions.explanation: Dawood received the Zabur.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was given the Injeel (Gospel)?
questions.explanation: Isa received the Injeel.

questions.prompt: Which prophet could understand the language of birds and animals?
questions.explanation: Sulaiman was granted command over creation.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is associated with the story of the golden calf?
questions.explanation: The calf was worshipped while Musa was on the mountain.

questions.prompt: Which prophet split the sea for his people?
questions.explanation: Musa parted the Red Sea.

questions.prompt: Which prophet built the Ark?
questions.explanation: Nuh built the Ark by Allah's command.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was raised to the heavens alive?
questions.explanation: Isa was raised by Allah.

questions.prompt: Which prophet is mentioned in the Quran as having been raised to a high place?
questions.explanation: Idris was raised to a lofty station.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was sent to the people of Thamud?
questions.explanation: Saleh was sent to Thamud with the she-camel miracle.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was sent to the people of Aad?
questions.explanation: Hud preached to the tribe of Aad.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was sent to the people of Midian?
questions.explanation: Shu'ayb was sent to Midian.

questions.prompt: Which prophet was the father of Prophet Yahya (AS)?
questions.explanation: Zakariyya was Yahya's father.

questions.prompt: The wife of Prophet Musa (AS), the daughter of Shu'ayb (AS), was named?
questions.explanation: Musa (AS) married Safura, the daughter of Shu'ayb (AS).

questions.prompt: The disbelieving wife of Prophet Lut (AS) suffered the same punishment as?
questions.explanation: Lut's (AS) wife sided with the people of Sodom and was destroyed with them.

questions.prompt: The disbelieving wives of Nuh (AS) and Lut (AS) are mentioned together in which Surah?
questions.explanation: Surah At-Tahrim (66:10-11) mentions the wives of Nuh and Lut as examples.

questions.prompt: The disbelieving son of Prophet Nuh (AS) who drowned in the flood was named?
questions.explanation: Nuh's (AS) son Kan'an refused to board the Ark and drowned.

questions.prompt: The title 'Khatam-un-Nabiyyin' given to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) means?
options: The seal of the prophets (the final prophet)
questions.explanation: Khatam-un-Nabiyyin means he is the final and last prophet (33:40).

questions.prompt: The angel appointed as the guardian of Hell is named?
questions.explanation: Malik is the keeper of Hell mentioned in Surah Az-Zukhruf (43:77).

questions.prompt: The angel appointed as the guardian of Paradise is named?
questions.explanation: Ridwan is the guardian of Jannah according to tradition.

questions.prompt: The 'Sidrat-ul-Muntaha' is best described as?
options: The Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary at the seventh heaven
questions.explanation: Sidrat-ul-Muntaha is the Lote Tree marking the boundary of the created realm.

questions.prompt: The bridge stretched over Hell that all must cross on the Day of Judgment is called?
questions.explanation: As-Sirat is the bridge over Hell, thinner than a hair and sharper than a sword.

questions.prompt: The scale on which deeds are weighed on the Day of Judgment is called?
questions.explanation: Al-Mizan is the balance of deeds on the Day of Judgment.

questions.prompt: The heavenly pool of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) from which believers will drink is called?
questions.explanation: Al-Hawd is the fountain of the Prophet (PBUH) at the Resurrection.

questions.prompt: The term 'Barzakh' refers to?
options: The interval between death and the Day of Judgment
questions.explanation: Barzakh is the barrier-state between this life and the Hereafter (23:100).

questions.prompt: According to a hadith, the very first thing Allah created was?
questions.explanation: The Prophet (PBUH) said the first creation was the Pen.

questions.prompt: The verse 'We sent you not but as a mercy to the worlds' is from which Surah?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Anbiya 21:107 describes the Prophet (PBUH) as a mercy to the worlds.

questions.prompt: The disciples of Prophet Isa (AS) are called in the Quran?
questions.explanation: The Quran calls the disciples of Isa (AS) al-Hawariyyun (3:52).

questions.prompt: The 'Dabbat al-Ard' (the Beast of the Earth) will appear before which event?
questions.explanation: The Beast of the Earth appears near the end of time before the Hour (27:82).

questions.prompt: The Arabic names of Gog and Magog are?
questions.explanation: Gog and Magog are Yajuj and Majuj in the Quran.

questions.prompt: The famous supplication of Yunus (AS) begins with the words?
options: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
questions.explanation: Yunus (AS) called out 'There is no god but You; glory be to You; I was of the wrongdoers' (21:87).

questions.prompt: According to the Quran, Adam (AS) was created from?
questions.explanation: Allah created Adam (AS) from clay (tin) and dust (15:26).

questions.prompt: According to the Quran and hadith, Hawwa (Eve) was created from?
questions.explanation: Eve was created from Adam's rib as mentioned in hadith.
